show.description: Ayush, a humble street chaat wala vendor, unexpectedly inherits a ₹2000 crore sweets empire after a mysterious encounter. True love Pooja is forced to leave him due to family pressures, pulling Ayush into an emotional battle alongside his rise to power.  Ayush fights back with courage and intelligence In the end, he exposes the truth, defeats his enemies, and wins back both his rightful position and his love.
